name: Svelte
tagline: A compiler for building reactive web interfaces.
hook: A minimal guide to contributor requirements, the full test suite, and a dedicated skill for performance work.
summary: Svelte's 11-line AGENTS.md points to existing contributor docs, requires the full test suite before a pull request, and sends performance investigations to a dedicated skill.

techniques.title: Delegate repository detail to the contributor guide
techniques.body: The root file identifies CONTRIBUTING.md as the place for testing, structure, and contribution rules. That lets the short agent entry point share an authority with human contributors.
techniques.quote: **Important:** Read and follow [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md) as well - it contains essential information about testing, code structure, and contribution guidelines that applies here.

techniques.title: Make the PR template and full suite explicit gates
techniques.body: Before submitting a pull request, the agent must read the template and run the full test suite. Both actions are named in the same instruction.
techniques.quote: When submitting a PR, you **MUST** read [`PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`](./.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) and fill it out correctly. **DO NOT** submit a PR without running the full test suite.

techniques.title: Route performance investigations to a skill
techniques.body: The final sentence names a specific skill when the task is a performance investigation. The general entry file stays short while task-specific procedure lives elsewhere.
techniques.quote: If asked to do a performance investigation, use the `performance-investigation` skill.

steal: Keep shared contributor rules in one authoritative document.
Name the checks and template required before a pull request.
Route specialized investigations to task-specific guides.
